description: Add one submission outcome to the shared outcome graph: which lender, what kind of file (bands), and the decision. No names, amounts or identifiers. Reports feed lender_stats, where a cell opens once outcomes from 5 distinct other reporters are in it; your own reports never count toward the 5, so no one can isolate another reporter’s outcome. Pass the same reporter_key (or X-AllClear-Key header) each time so your reports count as one reporter.

industry.description: Industry in a few words (e.g. "restaurants", "trucking", "dental practice"). No company names.

institution.description: Lender name as it appears in the directory, if no program_id.

reporter_key.description: Your own opaque key; stored hashed.

name: report_outcome
title: Report a lender decision (bands only)
